versions.subject: Add file_event_win_susp_executable_creation
versions.detection:
selection_double:
  TargetFilename|endswith: 
      - '.bat.exe'
      - '.sys.exe'
selection_folder:
  TargetFilename:
      - 'C:\$Recycle.Bin.exe'
      - 'C:\Documents and Settings.exe'
      - 'C:\MSOCache.exe'
      - 'C:\Recovery.exe'
      - 'C:\PerfLogs.exe'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: TargetFilename IN ("*.bat.exe", "*.sys.exe") OR TargetFilename IN ("C:\\$Recycle.Bin.exe", "C:\\Documents and Settings.exe", "C:\\MSOCache.exe", "C:\\Recovery.exe", "C:\\PerfLogs.exe")
